mapper.select: SELECT svv.*, vi.video_cover FROM (SELECT *, (SELECT video_id FROM pilipili.series_video sv WHERE sv.series_id = uvs.series_id ORDER BY sort ASC LIMIT 1) video_id FROM pilipili.user_video_series uvs WHERE user_id = #{userId}) svv LEFT JOIN pilipili.video_info vi ON vi.video_id = svv.video_id order by sort
mapper.insert: insert into pilipili.user_video_series(series_name, series_description, user_id, sort, update_time) values (#{seriesName}, #{seriesDescription}, #{userId}, #{sort}, now());

update.foreach: update pilipili.user_video_series set sort = #{item.sort} where user_id = #{item.userId} and series_id = #{item.seriesId}
